title: The Honoured Quote on Detoured Wayfare Rides Trips and the Wayfare Pass Member Discount
content:
On a detoured trip of **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)**, the honoured quote — what the rider owes for a trip the driver lengthened — is worked out from the **Wayfare Pass (rider membership)** membership in force at the request, set against the member discount recorded on the fare charge.

**Plan discount on the upfront fare.** The plan's member discount percent of the upfront fare less the ride option's booking fee, rounded half up to the cent.

## Rule

- Where the membership in force at the request is in trial, active or pending cancellation status, lists the ride option among its member discount options, and the discount recorded on the fare charge is larger than the plan discount on the upfront fare, the honoured quote is the upfront fare less that plan discount on the upfront fare.
- Where the membership is in no such status and the fare charge nevertheless records a member discount above zero, the honoured quote is the upfront fare with no discount.
- In any other case the honoured quote is not reworked by this rule.

## Decision table

| Status of the membership in force at the request | Ride option among its member discount options | Discount recorded on the fare charge | Honoured quote |
|---|---|---|---|
| trial, active or pending cancellation | yes | larger than the plan discount on the upfront fare | upfront fare less the plan discount on the upfront fare |
| trial, active or pending cancellation | yes | not larger than the plan discount on the upfront fare | not reworked |
| trial, active or pending cancellation | no | any | not reworked |
| any other status | — | above zero | upfront fare, no discount |
| any other status | — | zero | not reworked |

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

*Discount recorded on a lengthened fare.* Upfront fare $40.00; booking fee $3.10; active membership listing the ride option with a 10 percent plan discount; the recalculated fare carried a recorded discount of $4.30. Plan discount on the upfront fare: 10 percent of $36.90 is $3.69. $4.30 is larger, so the honoured quote is $40.00 less $3.69, that is **$36.31**.

*Discount recorded under a lapsed status.* Upfront fare $40.00; the membership is past due; the fare charge records a discount of $3.69. The honoured quote is **$40.00**.
